paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.

model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the relationship between percentage of in-context example pool and minFDE20. The x-axis is labeled "Percentage of In-Context Example Pool", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, and has tick labels incrementing by 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minFDE20 (-)", has a linear scale, ranges from 21.0 to 29.0, and has tick labels incrementing by 2.0. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “TrajICL” and begins at approximately 22.5 when the percentage of in-context examples is 0.0 and declines to approximately 21.5 when the percentage is 1.0, with a relatively steady decline. An orange line, marked with square data points, represents “Full FT” and begins at approximately 28.0 when the percentage of in-context examples is 0.0 then declines to approximately 25.0 when the percentage is 1.0, with a peak at around percentage of 0.4 where the value is 28.2.
